description: Gives every agent session a web page it writes for its task, and lets you answer from that page instead of chat. Each page is built for the task at hand: a diagram you click, a decision sheet, a report that shows what failed. Your choices and notes on the page arrive as the agent's next message, from bb or from your phone. A built-in home lists your sessions by what needs you and by project. Pages run sandboxed with no bb credentials, and anything that touches another session asks you first.
